*Greetings Program.  The Master Control Program has chosen you to serve your system on the Hive Blockchain.*

## For AI / agent developers

- Start here: [Building agents](https://developers.hive.io/quickstart/building_agents.html)
- Preferred stack: [WAX](https://doc.openhive.network/wax/) + [Beekeeper](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/beekeeper) for signing; [Workerbee](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/workerbee) / [@hiveio/workerbee](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hiveio/workerbee) for observe/fetch/submit
- Workerbee recipes: [getting started](https://developers.hive.io/tutorials-recipes/workerbee-getting-started.html), [subscribe/filter](https://developers.hive.io/tutorials-recipes/workerbee-subscribe-filter.html), [errors/reconnect](https://developers.hive.io/tutorials-recipes/workerbee-errors-reconnect.html)
- WAX agent docs index: [https://mintlify.com/openhive-network/wax/llms.txt](https://mintlify.com/openhive-network/wax/llms.txt) · site: [https://openhive-network-wax.mintlify.app/](https://openhive-network-wax.mintlify.app/)
- Public HTTPS nodes: [Hive Nodes](https://developers.hive.io/quickstart/#quickstart-hive-full-nodes) (e.g. `api.hive.blog`, `api.deathwing.me`, `anyx.io`)
- JSON-RPC methods: [https://developers.hive.io/apidefinitions/](https://developers.hive.io/apidefinitions/)
- OpenRPC export: [https://developers.hive.io/openrpc.json](https://developers.hive.io/openrpc.json) (OpenAPI overlay: [https://developers.hive.io/openapi.json](https://developers.hive.io/openapi.json))
- Auth safety: posting key / Keychain / Beekeeper; never put active/owner keys in prompts or logs — [Authentication](https://developers.hive.io/quickstart/#quickstart-authentication), [RC API](https://developers.hive.io/apidefinitions/#apidefinitions-rc-api)
- SDK table: [https://developers.hive.io/resources/#resources-sdk-reference](https://developers.hive.io/resources/#resources-sdk-reference)
- This file: [https://developers.hive.io/llms.txt](https://developers.hive.io/llms.txt)

{% assign llms_content = '# ' | append: site.title | append: newline | append: newline | append: site.description | append: newline | append: newline | append: '## Docs' | append: newline -%}
{%- assign sorted_nav = site.data.nav.toc | sort: "position" -%}
{%- for nav in sorted_nav -%}
  {%- assign nav_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl | append: nav.permalink -%}
  {%- assign col = site.collections | where: "id", nav.collection | first -%}
  {%- capture nav_title -%}{% t nav.title %}{%- endcapture -%}
  {%- assign llms_content = llms_content | append: newline | append: '### [' | append: nav_title | append: '](' | append: nav_url | append: ')' | append: newline -%}

  {%- if nav.docs -%}
    {%- assign sorted_doc_groups = nav.docs | sort: "position" -%}
    {%- for doc_group in sorted_doc_groups -%}
      {%- if doc_group.collection -%}
        {%- assign group_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl | append: '/' | append: doc_group.collection | append: '/' -%}
        {%- assign group_col = site.collections | where: "id", doc_group.collection | first -%}
        {%- capture group_title -%}{% t doc_group.title %}{%- endcapture -%}
        {%- assign llms_content = llms_content | append: '- [' | append: group_title | append: '](' | append: group_url | append: ')' | append: newline -%}
        {%- if group_col -%}
          {%- assign sorted_docs = group_col.docs | sort: "position" -%}
          {%- for doc in sorted_docs -%}
            {%- unless doc.sitemap == false or doc.exclude_in_index -%}
              {%- assign raw_path = doc.url | replace: "index.html", "" -%}
              {%- assign last_char = raw_path | slice: -1 -%}
              {%- if last_char == '/' or raw_path contains '.html' -%}
                {%- assign doc_path = raw_path -%}
              {%- else -%}
                {%- assign doc_path = raw_path | append: '.html' -%}
              {%- endif -%}
              {%- assign doc_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl | append: doc_path -%}
              {%- capture doc_title -%}{% t doc.title %}{%- endcapture -%}
              {%- assign llms_content = llms_content | append: '- [' | append: doc_title | append: '](' | append: doc_url | append: ')' | append: newline -%}
            {%- endunless -%}
          {%- endfor -%}
        {%- endif -%}
      {%- elsif doc_group.url -%}
        {%- assign doc_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl | append: nav.permalink | append: doc_group.url -%}
        {%- capture doc_title -%}{% t doc_group.title %}{%- endcapture -%}
        {%- assign llms_content = llms_content | append: '- [' | append: doc_title | append: '](' | append: doc_url | append: ')' | append: newline -%}
      {%- endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
  {%- elsif col -%}
    {%- assign sorted_docs = col.docs | sort: "position" -%}
    {%- for doc in sorted_docs -%}
      {%- unless doc.sitemap == false or doc.exclude_in_index -%}
        {%- if nav.collection == 'apidefinitions' -%}
          {%- assign doc_anchor = doc.id | slugify -%}
          {%- assign doc_path = nav.permalink | append: '#' | append: doc_anchor -%}
        {%- else -%}
          {%- assign raw_path = doc.url | replace: "index.html", "" -%}
          {%- assign last_char = raw_path | slice: -1 -%}
          {%- if last_char == '/' or raw_path contains '.html' -%}
            {%- assign doc_path = raw_path -%}
          {%- else -%}
            {%- assign doc_path = raw_path | append: '.html' -%}
          {%- endif -%}
        {%- endif -%}
        {%- assign doc_url = site.url | append: site.baseurl | append: doc_path -%}
        {%- capture doc_title -%}{% t doc.title %}{%- endcapture -%}
        {%- assign llms_content = llms_content | append: '- [' | append: doc_title | append: '](' | append: doc_url | append: ')' | append: newline -%}
      {%- endunless -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
